data.gender_notes: Dharun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dharun is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dharana’, which means ‘to hold, support, or uphold’. In Hindu mythology, Dharun is the name of the divine chariot driver who carries gods and goddesses to their respective battlefields. The name signifies strength, reliability, and unwavering support. The name Dharun carries the meaning “Supporter, Upholder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharun usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, upholder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
